components.title: Loading State
components.summary: Pixel-grid progress indicator with shimmer label and elapsed time.

components.title: Thinking
components.summary: Expandable staged trace for agent steps, reasoning, search, and coding work.

components.title: Streaming Text
components.summary: Animated answer stream with inline sources, actions, and follow-ups.

components.title: Approval Card
components.summary: Multi-step question card for obtaining an explicit human decision before an agent acts.

components.title: Tool Chips
components.summary: Compact expandable summary of code edits, tool calls, and messages.

components.title: Task Rows
components.summary: Live task rows that distinguish running, failed, and completed agent work.

components.title: Chat
components.summary: Tabbed conversation panel with reasoning replies and a message composer.

components.title: Prompt Bar
components.summary: Full-featured prompt composer with source tags, slash commands, model selection, and dictation affordances.

components.title: Recommendation Card
components.summary: Agent recommendation with confidence signal, alternative choices, and an accept action.

components.title: Context Cards
components.summary: Retrieved context snippets with source metadata and readable chunk previews.

components.title: Diff Table
components.summary: Review table for AI-proposed structured data changes before applying them.

components.title: Records Table
components.summary: Interactive CRM-like data grid with tags, sorting, filters, resizing, and relationship status.

components.title: Filter Table
components.summary: Status filter chips that reorganize a task table.

components.title: Sidebar Nav
components.summary: Collapsible workspace/chat navigation with gliding row highlights and account actions.

components.title: Search
components.summary: Command-style live filtering with results and an empty state.

components.title: Flowchart
components.summary: Draggable trigger-and-condition workflow steps on a dotted canvas.

components.title: Insight Cards
components.summary: Paged agent insight cards with scrub-ready time-series charts.

components.title: Code Block
components.summary: Line-numbered code viewer that switches between source and unified diff.

components.title: Fine-tune Card
components.summary: Property inspector where an agent or user adjusts layout, size, radius, opacity, and type.

components.title: Selection Actions
components.summary: Text-selection toolbar that hands a selected passage to the agent for a rewrite or other action.

components.title: Agent Screen
components.summary: Collapsible live-agent screen viewer with recording controls and a full-screen modal.
